title: Post Grid
description: A grid of blog post cards, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, a sentence of introduction and a link to every post, then one Card per post with its category Badge, date, linked title, excerpt and author Avatar, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the link to every post moves beside the heading at @sm, the posts sit in two columns and the heading steps up at @md, and three columns with more room at @lg.
